"""rcb_dtb — DexToolBench (SimToolReal) tasks in plain MuJoCo for robot_coding_bench.

Scene = SimToolReal's MuJoCo sim2sim scene (github.com/tylerlum/simtoolreal, MIT, deployment/mujoco/mujoco_sim.py),

flange, a 0.475 x 0.4 x 0.3 m table (top at z = 0.53 m), the tool (convex-decomposed meshes) and a green goal marker
(no contacts). Physics 600 Hz (implicitfast, elliptic cones, multi-CCD, gravity-compensated robot), control 60 Hz.

A task = one DexToolBench demo: a tool start pose and a sequence of goal poses (world frame). The benchmark's rule:
the current goal counts as reached when all 8 keypoints of the tool's grasp box (0.141 x 0.03025 x 0.0271 m, scaled
by 1.5) are within 1.5 cm of the same keypoints at the goal pose; then the next goal becomes current. Each goal has

trajectory = (T, 29) joint position targets, one row per control step (1/60 s), each held for 10 physics steps:
7 iiwa joints then the 22 Sharpa joints (names: JOINT_NAMES). Replaying it from the frozen start state is bit-exact.

import numpy as np
import mujoco, rcb_dtb
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from PIL import Image
import argparse, json

class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data;self.k=mujoco.MjData(self.m);self.b=self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id
  self.jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));self.jr=self.jp.copy();self.q=s.state()['q'].copy()
 def pose(self):return self.d.xpos[self.b].copy(),self.d.xmat[self.b].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def ik(self,p,R,q=None):
  q=self.q.copy() if q is None else q.copy();self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
  for _ in range(35):
   self.k.qpos[self.s._jq]=q;mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,self.k)
   e=np.r_[p-self.k.xpos[self.b],Rotation.from_matrix(R@self.k.xmat[self.b].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(e)<1e-5:break
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.k,self.jp,self.jr,self.b)
   J=np.r_[self.jp[:,self.s._jv[:7]],self.jr[:,self.s._jv[:7]]]
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,e)
   q[:7]=np.clip(q[:7]+dq*np.minimum(1,.12/(np.max(np.abs(dq))+1e-9)),self.s.lower[:7]+.01,self.s.upper[:7]-.01)
  return q
 def move(self,p,R=None,hand=None,n=120):
  p0,R0=self.pose();R=R0 if R is None else R; rv=Rotation.from_matrix(R@R0.T).as_rotvec()
  h0=self.q[7:].copy();hand=h0 if hand is None else hand
  for i in range(n):
   a=(i+1)/n;a=a*a*(3-2*a)
   self.q=self.ik(p0+(p-p0)*a,Rotation.from_rotvec(rv*a).as_matrix()@R0)
   self.q[7:]=h0+(hand-h0)*a
   self.s.step(self.q)
 def hold(self,n=60):
  for i in range(n):self.s.step(self.q)
 def snap(self,name):
  Image.fromarray(self.s.render_grid(size=(640,480))).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png')
  print(name,'steps',self.s.steps,'obj',self.s.state()['object_pos'],'hand',self.pose()[0],'qhand',self.s.state()['q'][7:],'progress',self.s.progress(),flush=True)
  cs=[]
  for con in self.d.contact:
   if self.m.geom_bodyid[con.geom1]==self.s._obj or self.m.geom_bodyid[con.geom2]==self.s._obj:
    force=np.zeros(6);mujoco.mj_contactForce(self.m,self.d,con.id,force) if hasattr(con,'id') else None
    cs.append((self.m.geom(con.geom1).name,self.m.geom(con.geom2).name,float(con.dist)))
  print('contacts',cs,flush=True)

def hand(c=.9,t=.9):
 h=np.zeros(22);h[:5]=[t,0,t,0,t]
 for j in [5,9,13,18]:h[j:j+4]=[c,0,c,c]
 return h

def main():
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--x',type=float,default=.09);ap.add_argument('--y',type=float,default=.20);ap.add_argument('--z',type=float,default=.621);ap.add_argument('--curl',type=float,default=1.1);ap.add_argument('--thumb',type=float,default=.7);args=ap.parse_args()
 s=rcb_dtb.Session();s.record_start();c=Controller(s)
 R=np.array([[0.,1,0],[0,0,-1],[-1,0,0]])
 c.move(np.array([args.x,args.y,.72]),R,n=100)
 c.move(np.array([args.x,args.y,args.z]),R,n=120);c.snap('approach')
 c.move(np.array([args.x,args.y,args.z]),R,hand(args.curl,args.thumb),n=120);c.hold(30);c.snap('grasp')
 c.move(np.array([args.x,args.y,args.z+.13]),R,n=150);c.hold(60);c.snap('lift')
 A=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(A);print('result',s.progress())
 if s._renderer:s._renderer.close()
if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Generate and verify joint targets for claw_hammer / swing_side.

The controller approaches with an open hand, establishes a thumb stop, curls
four fingers, lifts, then tightens the grasp. Tool pose feedback supplies small
rigid motions of the palm, converted to arm targets by damped inverse kinematics.
Only Session.step joint targets affect the recorded physical rollout.
"""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import mujoco
import rcb_dtb
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

OUT = Path('/app/output')


class Controller:
    def __init__(self, session):
        self.s = session
        self.m = session.model
        self.d = session.data
        # A separate data object is used only for kinematic calculations.
        self.k = mujoco.MjData(self.m)
        self.b = self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id
        self.jp = np.zeros((3, self.m.nv))
        self.jr = self.jp.copy()
        self.q = session.state()['q'].copy()

    def pose(self):
        return self.d.xpos[self.b].copy(), self.d.xmat[self.b].reshape(3, 3).copy()

    def ik(self, p, rotation):
        q = self.q.copy()
        self.k.qpos[:] = self.d.qpos
        for _ in range(35):
            self.k.qpos[self.s._jq] = q
            mujoco.mj_forward(self.m, self.k)
            error = np.r_[p - self.k.xpos[self.b],
                Rotation.from_matrix(rotation @ self.k.xmat[self.b].reshape(3, 3).T).as_rotvec()]
            if np.linalg.norm(error) < 1e-5:
                break
            mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m, self.k, self.jp, self.jr, self.b)
            jac = np.r_[self.jp[:, self.s._jv[:7]], self.jr[:, self.s._jv[:7]]]
            dq = jac.T @ np.linalg.solve(jac @ jac.T + np.eye(6) * 1e-5, error)
            q[:7] = np.clip(q[:7] + dq * np.minimum(1, .12 / (np.max(np.abs(dq)) + 1e-9)),
                           self.s.lower[:7] + .01, self.s.upper[:7] - .01)
        return q

    def move(self, p, rotation=None, hand=None, n=120):
        p0, r0 = self.pose()
        rotation = r0 if rotation is None else rotation
        rv = Rotation.from_matrix(rotation @ r0.T).as_rotvec()
        h0 = self.q[7:].copy()
        hand = h0 if hand is None else hand
        for i in range(n):
            a = (i + 1) / n
            a = a * a * (3 - 2 * a)
            self.q = self.ik(p0 + (p - p0) * a, Rotation.from_rotvec(rv * a).as_matrix() @ r0)
            self.q[7:] = h0 + (hand - h0) * a
            self.s.step(self.q)

    def hold(self, n):
        for _ in range(n):
            self.s.step(self.q)


def hand_shape(curl, thumb):
    hand = np.zeros(22)
    hand[:5] = thumb
    for j in [5, 9, 13, 18]:
        hand[j:j + 4] = [curl, 0, curl, curl]
    return hand


def main():
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    s = rcb_dtb.Session('/app/instance.json')
    s.record_start()
    c = Controller(s)
    rotation = np.array([[0., 1, 0], [0, 0, -1], [-1, 0, 0]])
    position = np.array([.09, .20, .597])
    initial_hand = hand_shape(.85, [.9952, -.0187, .6869, -.1751, .6784])

    c.move(np.array([.09, .20, .72]), rotation, n=100)
    c.move(position, rotation, n=120)
    thumb_stop = initial_hand.copy()
    thumb_stop[5:] = 0
    c.move(position, rotation, thumb_stop, n=80)
    c.move(position, rotation, initial_hand, n=120)
    c.hold(30)
    c.move(position + [0, 0, .10], rotation, n=150)
    c.hold(30)
    closed_hand = hand_shape(1.2, [1.2, .2, 1.2, 0, 1.2])
    c.move(c.pose()[0], c.pose()[1], closed_hand, n=120)
    c.hold(60)

    previous_goal = 0
    for _ in range(10000):
        if s.goal_index >= len(s.goals) or s.failed:
            break
        goal = np.array(s.goals[s.goal_index])
        object_position = s.data.xpos[s._obj].copy()
        object_rotation = s.data.xmat[s._obj].reshape(3, 3).copy()
        palm_position, palm_rotation = c.pose()
        goal_rotation = Rotation.from_quat(goal[3:]).as_matrix()
        error = goal[:3] - object_position
        rv = Rotation.from_matrix(goal_rotation @ object_rotation.T).as_rotvec()
        # Retain all rotational components, including rotation about the handle.
        rv = rv - (1 - 1.0) * np.dot(rv, object_rotation[:, 0]) * object_rotation[:, 0]
        gain = min(.15, .002 / (np.linalg.norm(error) + 1e-9), .015 / (np.linalg.norm(rv) + 1e-9))
        dr = Rotation.from_rotvec(gain * rv).as_matrix()
        desired_position = object_position + gain * error + dr @ (palm_position - object_position)
        c.q = c.ik(desired_position, dr @ palm_rotation)
        s.step(c.q)
        if s.goal_index != previous_goal:
            print(f'Reached {s.goal_index}/{len(s.goals)} at step {s.steps}', flush=True)
            previous_goal = s.goal_index

    actions = s.record_stop()
    original_hash = s.state_sha()
    original_progress = s.progress()
    assert original_progress['done'], original_progress
    assert actions.ndim == 2 and actions.shape[1] == 29
    assert len(actions) <= 360000 and np.isfinite(actions).all()
    s.save_trajectory(actions)
    replay = s.replay(actions)
    assert replay['done'] and replay['state_sha'] == original_hash, replay
    report = {'shape': list(actions.shape), 'generation_state_sha': original_hash, 'replay': replay}
    s.save_trajectory(actions, meta=report)
    (OUT / 'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
